_about: Reworded operator notes with the expected structured directive. Used by scripts/run_paraphrases.py to measure interpretation accuracy of the configured model. capacity is the battery capacity used for percent-based reserves.

items.note: PV production will drop to about 20% between 13:00 and 15:00.
Panel washing from one until three will leave roughly one-fifth of normal solar output.
Expect an 80% reduction in rooftop solar during the 1-3 PM maintenance window.
Solar generation will be cut by 40% from 9 AM to noon because scaffolding shades the array.
Only half of the forecast PV will be usable between 10:00 and 13:00 while the inverters are serviced.
The rooftop array is offline for inspection from 11 AM until 1 PM, so there is no solar in that period.
Treat solar as three-quarters of the forecast from 2 PM to 5 PM because of haze.
Keep at least 120 kWh in reserve from 6 PM until 9 PM.
Hospital backup requires the battery to hold no less than 60 kWh between 20:00 and 23:00.
Maintain a battery reserve of 40% of capacity from 5 PM to 7 PM.
The battery should stay at least half full from 7 PM until midnight.
Don't let stored battery energy fall below 75 kWh during the 4 PM to 6 PM fire drill.
Do not charge the battery between 2 PM and 4 PM.
The charger is offline for repairs from 1 AM to 4 AM.
No battery charging is permitted between 22:00 and 24:00.
The charging inverter is isolated during the 3 AM hour.
The battery cannot take any charge from 11 PM to 2 AM while firmware is patched.
For protection testing, the battery must not discharge from 6 PM until 8 PM.
Battery output is locked out between 17:00 and 19:00 for relay checks.
Discharging is prohibited from noon to 3 PM while the protection relays are tested.
The battery must not supply the campus load during the 9 PM hour.
From 6 PM until 9 PM, campus grid import must not exceed 155 kWh in any hour.
The feeder can only deliver 140 kWh per hour between 5 PM and 8 PM.
Grid purchases are capped at 200 kWh an hour from 19:00 to 22:00 due to substation work.
Utility request: keep grid intake at or below 120 kWh from 8 PM onward.
The cafeteria menu changes tomorrow.
Solar panels on the library roof will be cleaned next week.
Last month's electricity bill has been sent to the finance office.
The battery supplier will visit next Monday for a warranty review.
Remember that evening tariffs are usually higher than morning tariffs.
The sports office moved next month's registration deadline.
Tomorrow the grid import limit will be 150 kWh from 6 PM to 9 PM.
